title: Extraction and Debt Anew
author: Wren Ishikawa
blurb: Isandro Halloran, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
